models.notes: Uncensored variant of qwen3.6-35b-a3b: Heretic v1.2.0 (MPOA) on the official Qwen weights, only o_proj/out_proj/down_proj edited, no fine-tune or merge. The embedded chat template is llmfan46's adaptation of froggeric's template against tool-call loops (https://huggingface.co/llmfan46/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-uncensored-heretic/discussions/3; one user report, not measured), not the official one; it keeps the official tool-call format.
